text: Primo Golf Apparel is owned by its four founders, cousins Matty Gay, Jason Williamson, Jordan Williamson and Kirk Williamson, together with YouTube golfer Grant Horvat, who became the first owner outside the founding family in March 2024.
short: Primo Golf is owned by its four founding cousins and part-owner Grant Horvat
